legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is freely assignable by the Assignee without the consent of the Seller or Assignor.
legal_clauses.indemnification: The Assignor and Seller shall jointly and severally indemnify the Assignee against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from any breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any disputes arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: The Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations, including but not limited to title insurance, transfer taxes, and recording fees.
